experience.title: Information Technology Help Desk Specialist
responsibilities: Diagnose and resolve technical hardware and software issues via phone and email, documenting all activity
Communicate complex technical information clearly to customers
Maintain accurate customer records and process changes
Research and advise users on appropriate actions
Log help desk interactions and identify urgent situations
Track and route problems and requests, documenting resolutions
Maintain ticketing system and route tickets to appropriate parties

experience.title: Quality Assurance IT Analyst
responsibilities: Organize and follow detailed technical procedures
Establish and implement quality assurance and compliance processes
Serve as process owner for document control, corrective/preventive action, internal auditing, and KPI tracking
Utilize advanced Excel for data analysis and reporting
Train and mentor others in quality tools and statistical methods
Extract and transform raw data into summary charts and reports
Develop metrics for new projects and document findings
Collaborate with production and development teams to implement reporting solutions
Consult with IT and business leaders on strategic solutions

experience.title: Business Operations Analyst /Metrics Analyst /Department Administrative Support/ Supply Chain Assistant
responsibilities: Provide accurate reporting to executive management
Import and export data from SAP and SharePoint
Create PowerPoint presentations for executive briefings
Manage metrics such as shipments, order cycle time, inventory, and forecasting
Use advanced Excel for data manipulation and analysis
Implement metric management tools and support daily/monthly/quarterly metrics
Resolve data and system issues and maintain internal site
Assist buyers in procurement and supply chain activities
Update inventory database and create purchase orders and invoices
Monitor shipping and logistics operations
Provide administrative support to department manager, organize meetings, prepare presentations, and arrange travel

experience.title: Customer Service Professional
responsibilities: Answer incoming customer calls and investigate inquiries via phone, fax, email, Shell Source, and EDI
Enter orders and resolve issues using SAP/CRM and Remedy
Research and resolve complaints and assign/escape issues as needed
Maintain relationships with sales, customers, and suppliers
